title: Drizzle schema for one domain module

module.description: Domain module name, plural kebab-case (e.g. tasks, order-items).

fields.description: Comma-separated name:type pairs; a trailing ? marks the column nullable, and string takes an optional length in parentheses (default 255). Types: string, text, boolean, integer, timestamp. Example: title:string(500),done:boolean,dueDate:timestamp?
